input.rationale: Article 12 contains detailed reversion mechanics running to Harpoon (Sections 12.6-12.7), a sell-off right (12.10.2) and survival provisions, but no obligation on Harpoon to support AbbVie's wind-down or to return AbbVie's data on expiry or termination. The only return mechanic is Section 9.7, which is request-based, lets Harpoon elect destruction instead of delivery, and sets no deadline ("as soon as reasonably practicable"); Harpoon's other assistance obligations (e.g., Sections 3.12, 4.x) operate during the Term only. The rule therefore fails at the fallback. We insert a new Section 12.11 at the fallback level: at least 90 days of transition assistance available on any expiry or termination, and return of AbbVie data within 30 days, expressed as prevailing over the Section 9.7 destruction election so the two mechanics do not conflict. We did not volunteer the preferred six-month period, then-current-rate charging, machine-readable format or deletion certification.

proposal.summary: Insert Section 12.11 requiring Harpoon, on any expiry or termination, to provide at least 90 days of transition assistance and to return AbbVie's data within 30 days.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article 12 gives Harpoon reversion rights but gives us no exit support, and Section 9.7 only offers a request-based return that Harpoon may satisfy by destruction on no fixed timetable. We added our fallback transition position: at least 90 days of assistance on any expiry or termination and return of our data within 30 days.

ops.text: Transition Assistance; Return of AbbVie Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Harpoon shall (a) at AbbVie's request, provide AbbVie with reasonable transition assistance for a period of at least ninety (90) days following the effective date of such expiration or termination, and (b) notwithstanding Section 9.7, within thirty (30) days after such effective date, return to AbbVie all data and other Confidential Information of AbbVie in Harpoon's possession or Control.
